paper_title: First indirect detection constraints on axions in the Solar basin
notes: Paper sets limits on both g_agamma (Fig. 2, gaee=0) and g_aee/f. Values here approximate the CLs limit on g_agamma from Fig. 2 (m in keV converted to eV). The paper also constrains axion-electron coupling; primary photon-only limit shown in Fig 2. Data read approximately from figure since no numerical table given; values are estimates. Mass range of stated world-leading limits is 5-30 keV. | selector: text (sole candidate)
